en: The trees are so dense here.
Looks like a face in the tree!
See how the branches hang down?
These trees are rather short, no?
It grows like there's a constant wind.
These seem to grow at a specific elevation.
What a pleasing variety of shrubbery.
Is it a dull orange all year long?
It's like the top's on fire!
Such a wide and branching trunk.
Is that the fabled running tree?
I bet the ground never gets wet here.
Some sort of fruit growing here.
Do you think the trunk keeps curving?
A tree of fire and blood.
The leaves are pink on the underside!
Is this a tree or some kind of fungus?
What a nice orderly arrangement of green.
It's happy to spread its crimson canopy!
What's that red stuff dripping down?
Bushy tufts springing from a calcified trunk.
Mossy base, thick trunk, spherical crown.
I see evil faces between the green...
Not leaves but long webbed spines.
Seriously, another variation of green tree?
Not leaves at all but glowing membranous sacs!
Thick sap has leaked and solidified.
Almost like cotton candy. But nobody taste it!
These silver bushes could be mistaken for rock formations.
Topped with a fuzzy red carpet.
This tree sends out roots that sprout saplings.
was sprayed by a small animal
I think I'll keep it on the bridge.

I can feel the power radiating from it.
It seems to have a dark aura.
No one is talking about it.
I want to keep it forever.
